originalR7Gate: Four failed full-matrix cells preserved; no waiver, metric change or replacement.
guards: Exact frozen getByText(jobName,{exact:true}).first() target and same default point algorithm in both modes; unique visible/enabled target and visible interactive job-card ancestry; destination initially hidden; trusted target pointer/click and subsequent DOM-ready events required.

interpretation: Force reduces request-to-pointer medians from 33.3→7.8 ms baseline and 36.2→8.1 ms R7, with click-to-DOM-ready 9.3 ms default/9.1 ms force in both sources. R7 pointerdown-to-click remains 4.5–4.6 ms versus 1.7–2.0 ms baseline. This demonstrates a substantial shared actionability-factor contribution in this instrumented experiment, not that default is invalid, that all original delay is Playwright, or that a specific app component caused a delay.
limitations: Separate instrumented protocol; original frozen gate and failed candidate remain unchanged.
DOM visibility and rAF callbacks are readiness/paint opportunities, not physical first paint or compositor display.
MutationObserver, continuous rAF and PerformanceObserver add browser work; both sources receive identical instrumentation.
Two isolated app servers run concurrently; idle-server overhead is a supplemental diagnostic difference.
No true device/production auth/private SW/background-update/offline target proof.
Shared host production/OS activity remains uncontrolled.
Force skips multiple page prechecks, element states, frame hit-testing and interception/post-interception waits. It is not a stable-rAF-only factor.
Source target and default center-point algorithm are unchanged; actual sampled coordinates need not be identical if layout changes over time.
Additional target guards, browser click-request probe, rAF/DOM/longtask observers alter phase alignment. Default medians here are not comparable substitutes for original full-gate medians.
Office only, five samples per source/mode; all 20 samples retained. No actual first-paint/physical/offline/Next-privateSW/update proof.
No new app source/variant build; original failed candidate gate remains authoritative.
No declared heavy agent/ADB/phone work; production/OS activity remained uncontrolled.
